notes: Flagged unit 27 (s026 ʾăšer + s028 lə + s029 hem → whereunto) is genuinely indivisible: the one English word carries the relative, the unto relation and the resumption, so rule 30's condition is met and rule 22's first sentence does not reach the suffix; retained, headed on the relative (rule 23).
The opening And if is one rendering of the single waw under rule 55's contiguity test, since no other conjunction stands in the clause; the italic other (t013) is the verse's only added unit.
hāyāh … lənāšîm is split as elsewhere in the chapter: the verb takes they be, nāšîm takes married, and the lamed is unrepresented under rules 21 and 40.
